io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.machines

Class MachineProcessor<T extends MachineOperation>

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.machines.MachineProcessor<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - The type of MachineOperation this processor can hold.

    public class MachineProcessor<T extends MachineOperation>
extends java.lang.Object
    A MachineProcessor manages different MachineOperations and handles their progress.
